decisions.decision: Graph panel: percentile-based coordinate normalisation in precompute script
decisions.rationale: ForceAtlas2 outliers stretched bounding box, 97% of nodes clustered in one quadrant

decisions.decision: nodeCanvasObject rendering with hover highlighting and click tooltips
decisions.rationale: Match entity detail page UX — labels on zoom/hover, positioned tooltip on click

decisions.decision: Tooltip appended to .graph-panel container (not .graph-canvas) to avoid overflow:hidden clipping
decisions.rationale: graph-canvas has overflow:hidden which clips absolutely-positioned tooltips

decisions.decision: npm build scripts produce all three Pagefind indices (descriptions, entities, places)
decisions.rationale: Previously only CI built separate indices; local builds produced a single default index

decisions.decision: MAJOR UX PIVOT — switch from full-width graph above results to three-column layout per Figma alt design
decisions.rationale: 100 nodes with 1428 edges is a hairball. Alt design: filters|results|graph as sticky right panel showing ego-subset of ~15-25 nodes focused on one entity. Enables infinite exploration.

decisions.decision: Graph and results list become interconnected — graph drives results, filter pills reflect graph state, Pagefind search works alongside
decisions.rationale: User wants the explorer graph to be an open-ended discovery tool unlike the entity detail page graph which is a dead end
